    Degree-one Ext from a short projective presentation #

    For a short exact sequence 0 ⟶ K ⟶ P ⟶ X ⟶ 0 with projective middle term, this file identifies Ext¹(X,Y) with the quotient of Hom(K,Y) by maps which extend across P. The equivalence is also proved natural under postcomposition in Y.
